meta.title: Workshops for Schools & Colleges — ATHYKA
meta.description: Hands-on workshops in software, automation and AI. We come to your campus.

hero.h1:
Your students know the theory.
Have they *built* anything?
hero.sub: Hands-on workshops in software, automation and AI. We come to your campus.
hero.microcopy: For schools & colleges — we come to you.

items.provocation: Final-year projects that all look the same.
items.solution: Build-first sessions where every student ships something different

items.provocation: Industry moves fast. The syllabus doesn't.
items.solution: Workshops in what teams actually use today: software, automation, AI

items.provocation: A guest lecture is forgotten by Monday.
items.solution: Hands-on days students remember, and mention in interviews
